title: What Is a Game World?
goal: A world is a stage with a floor, sky, and stuff.
mascot_lines: Every game lives inside a little world.
The world has rules — like which way is down and what makes you bump.
Worlds need a hero who lives in them and stuff for the hero to do.
When we change the rules of the world, we change the whole game.

tier2.rephrase: Pick the part that is NOT in a normal game world.

tier3.nudge: Floor, sky, hero, blocks — all in. What does NOT belong?

payload.prompt: Which is NOT a part of a game world?

reflect.prompt: Imagine YOUR own game world. Who lives there? What do they want?
reflect.hook: My world is a place where...
questions: What do they want or need?
